10591609.ch: 心情失落，于家中闭门数月不出。

10591610.en: Made another try to practice Mind Skills, but in vain as usual.
10591610.ch: 振作心情，重练心法，然而一如往日，毫无动静。

10591611.en: Went into Hundred Thousand Hills but encountered Dangkang, and got lost there.
10591611.ch: 打算前往十万大山探秘，结果遭到当康拦截，逃命期间迷失山中。

10591612.en: Fled from Hundred Thousand Hills but then fell ill due to miasma.
10591612.ch: 逃出十万大山，然而遭遇瘴气侵袭，回家病倒。

10591613.en: Recovered and went to Manual Pavilion for manuals suitable to those with feeble spiritual roots.
10591613.ch: 病愈复出，前往琅琊阁查找适合灵根软弱者修炼秘籍。

10591614.en: Traveled to the side of the East Sea and was impressed by the sites left in controlling floods.
10591614.ch: 于东海边缘游玩，觅得治水遗迹，于其流连数日，生出感慨。

10591615.en: Gazed at the Nether Mountains and felt a sense of melancholy.
10591615.ch: 远眺冥山簇拥围绕的高峰，心中生出悲凉之感。

10591616.en: Read manuals for months behind closed doors.
10591616.ch: 回到家中研读秘籍，数月不出。

10591617.en: Exhausted by excessive reading and fell ill after spitting a pool of blood.
10591617.ch: 研读秘籍，耗尽心力，吐血数升，病倒卧床。

10591618.en: Recovered and went for Supreme Forge again.
10591618.ch: 病愈复出，再次踏上探寻秘境大冶台的旅程。

10591620.en: Found a manual titled Reverse Blood Technique and practiced it for months.
10591620.ch: 尝试修炼秘法《逆血大法》，闭关数月

10591621.en: Went to a master cultivator for the ineffective practice, but the visit was declined.
10591621.ch: 修炼无果，前往咨询修仙大能，遭受冷遇。

10591622.en: Went to a secluded master cultivator's residence for the remedy of feeble spiritual roots, but was turned down.
10591622.ch: 前往某隐世大能家中，寻求纠正灵根之法。遭受冷遇。

10591623.en: Climbed to a mountain's top for sightseeing and sang all worries out.
10591623.ch: 前往州中高山，俯瞰胜景，期间仰天长啸，一抒胸臆。

10591624.en: Set out again for herbs in a mystic realm.
10591624.ch: 再次启程，前往秘境探寻秘药。

10591625.en: Found the herb had been eaten by monsters and could only be back.
10591625.ch: 灵药已遭妖兽吞没，失望而归。

10591626.en: Rested in home and stood motionlessly in rain for half a day.
10591626.ch: 于家中休养，期间于雨中呆站半日。

10591627.en: Took a mysterious pill and suffered for months under its effect.
10591627.ch: 尝试吞服奇药，遭遇药力反噬，病倒数月。

10591628.en: Recovered again and went to a sect for a visit, but was expelled.
10591628.ch: 病愈复出，前往某宗门拜山，遭到驱逐。

10591629.en: Drank in a tavern and thought for half a day, and cheered up again.
10591629.ch: 于州中酒馆小酌，苦思半日，再次振作精神。

10591630.en: Went to Manual Pavilion with collected spiritual items in exchange for the information of Supreme Forge.
10591630.ch: 前往琅琊阁，献出昔日探险所得灵物，祈求琅琊阁协助打探大冶台之事。

10591700.en: Went to the mountains for mysterious herbs, but found nothing.
10591700.ch: 前往山中寻觅仙草，最终废然而返。

10591701.en: Was mocked by cultivators and in low spirits for days.
10591701.ch: 遭到州中修士鄙夷，失落数日。

10591702.en: Practiced a new technique but got Qi out of control and had to rest for half a month.
10591702.ch: 尝试新的修炼方法，结果导致气冲脏腑，重病不起，卧床半月。

10591703.en: Got struck by a trial from a cultivator's breakthrough and was left in a coma for days.
10591703.ch: 在野外探索期间，遭遇修仙者突破触发之天劫，不慎受到波及，重伤晕倒数日。

10591704.en: Tried to absorb Qi but failed, and cheered up only after half a month.
10591704.ch: 尝试吸纳灵气未果，失落半月这才重新振奋。

10591705.en: Visited a master cultivator for the remedy to the constitution, but was turned down.
10591705.ch: 前往拜会一名修仙大能以求根治体质，遭到拒绝。

10591706.en: Read manuals in the residence for days.
10591706.ch: 于住处研读秘籍，数日不出。

10591707.en: Wanted to visit a friend, but found the person's door closed.
10591707.ch: 前往拜会友人，然而吃了闭门羹。

10591708.en: Stayed at home for half a month.
10591708.ch: 于家中逗留半月，闭门不出。

10591709.en: Fell into a drunken sleep aside an open window and caught cold, and rested for days.
10591709.ch: 于家中买醉数日，卧倒窗前，为风邪入侵，病倒数日。

10591710.en: Tried to ride on an artifact but fell from the air, and was injured heavily.
10591710.ch: 勉强驾驭法器，期间从高空跌落，致重伤卧床。

10591711.en: Tried to refine Qi by dragging a heavy sword for months.
10591711.ch: 锲而不舍，终月拖动重剑练气。

10591712.en: Completed a town mission after many narrow escapes.
10591712.ch: 几经风险，侥幸完成城镇任务。

10591713.en: Wanted to find manuals in Manual Pavilion and stayed there for half a month.
10591713.ch: 进入琅琊阁中寻觅秘籍，半月不出。

10591714.en: Visited a sect and implored to be accepted, but was declined.
10591714.ch: 前往某宗门拜山，恳请收录门墙，后遭拒绝。

10303477.en: Chased by mysterious persons in black many times.
10303477.ch: 屡次遭遇黑衣神秘人追杀。

10303478.en: Had severe fevers and could only rest at home.
10303478.ch: 身体频繁出现高烧，无奈于家中静养。

10303479.en: Tried to find a mysterious crystal in the hills but failed.
10303479.ch: 于山中寻觅神秘晶石，但废然而返。

10303480.en: Pierced the head with a strand-shaped artifact and survived after spitting much blood.
10303480.ch: 尝试以发丝状神秘法宝刺入头顶，结果呕血数升，侥幸生还。

10303481.en: Went to a strange place and burned clusters of poisonous plants there.
10303481.ch: 前往奇特的洞天烧毁大片毒草。

10303482.en: Fell into a coma in the mountains and woke up only after many days.
10303482.ch: 于山中昏迷，接连数日不醒。

10303483.en: Went to the arena of the Immortal Tournament to deliver an item.
10303483.ch: 前往升仙大会比试现场，交付物品。

10303484.en: Entered into a mysterious building and showed up again after many months.
10303484.ch: 进入神秘建筑，数月不出。

10303485.en: Took poison but managed to find an antidote in the hills despite suffering from the drug.
10303485.ch: 尝试吞服毒药，于身中剧毒的情况下，成功于山中觅得解药除去毒质。

10303487.en: Had a discussion with several persons in black for some days.
10303487.ch: 与数名神秘人来往，并议事数日。

10303488.en: Had a prolonged fever this month and could only rest at home.
10303488.ch: 该月身体接连高烧，无奈于家中静养。

10303490.en: Entered a secret place and made a detailed record before retreating.
10303490.ch: 进入某神秘地点探索，笔录大量资料，并成功退走。

10303491.en: Went into the mountains for an exploration and only returned after a long time.
10303491.ch: 进入某山探索，久久不归。

10303492.en: Went into the mountains for a tea that can keep persons always sober.
10303492.ch: 进入深山搜寻能够使人长久保持清醒的茶茗。

10303493.en: Fell into a coma in the street of a town in Yun Mo and had a quarrel with cultivators after woke up.
10303493.ch: 于云陌州城镇大街突然昏迷，醒觉后与修仙者发生争执。

10303494.en: Chased by a mysterious person in black and could only escape into remote mountains.
10303494.ch: 被神秘黑衣人追杀数日，躲入深山，成功将之摆脱。

10303495.en: Got injured in an exploration and rested at home.
10303495.ch: 外出受伤而回，于家中静养。

10303496.en: Set barriers around the residence to keep outsiders away.
10303496.ch: 于住处附近布置迷障，防止外人轻易进入。

10303497.en: Searched for something in the mountains but failed.
10303497.ch: 进入山间搜索半日，废然而回。

10303498.en: Climbed onto a hill near the residence and thought for a long time.
10303498.ch: 于居所附近登高临远，期间苦思良久。

10303499.en: Fell into a coma during an exploration into the hills and only woke up after a long time.
10303499.ch: 外出探索，突然晕倒山间，多时才又醒转。

10303500.en: Went to a market in a town but drew other's attention due to an unstable personality.
10303500.ch: 进入城中采购物品，突然间性情大变，惹来旁人侧目。

10303501.en: Felt exhausted under severe fevers and could only rest at home for half a month.
10303501.ch: 感觉全身高热，辛苦难耐，于家中养病半月。

10303502.en: Had a chat with a mysterious person near the residence for half a day.
10303502.ch: 神秘人来访，与其于居所附近隐秘之地谈论半日。

10303503.en: Went into a secret place with a mysterious figure and returned with slight wounds during a fight.
10303503.ch: 随同神秘人前往隐秘之地，发生激战，并受轻伤而回。

10303504.en: Drank much strong tea at home to keep sober.
10303504.ch: 于家中连喝浓茶，疑似竭力保持清醒。

10303505.en: Was ambushed by a mysterious figure and defeated the opponent after a harsh battle.
10303505.ch: 遭到神秘人袭击，与其战斗多时，终于取胜。

10304397.en: Set off for an exploration after visiting a village in Hua Feng.
10304397.ch: 前往华封州某村落拜访后，再次对该州进行探索。

10304398.en: Got exhausted after days of perusing notes and manuals.
10304398.ch: 于家中日夜翻看笔记典籍，致身心疲倦。

10304399.en: Wounded in a fight against a cultivator in Hua Feng and hid in a cave for rest.
10304399.ch: 与华封州修仙者交手失利受伤，无奈与山野洞窟藏匿，将养伤势。

10304400.en: Explored mystic realms in Hua Feng and got treasures and Spiritual Fruits.
10304400.ch: 前往华封州数处秘境进行探索，收获若干宝物与灵果。

10304401.en: Visited the elderly villagers in Hua Feng and stayed in the village for months of research.
10304401.ch: 前往华封州某村落拜访村中耆宿，并于村中留住，钻研周边风物数月。

10304402.en: Bought a long-lost map at the auction with some unknown means.
10304402.ch: 通过不为人知的手段，从拍卖会中，拍得一份失传地理图籍。

10304403.en: Fell ill due to excessive work and recovered after several months.
10304403.ch: 身心透支，累倒家中，将养月余康复。

10304404.en: Followed by cultivators in Hua Feng and could only conceal the dwelling by a special array.
10304404.ch: 受到华封州修仙者跟踪，无奈下设置特殊阵法隐匿住处。

10304405.en: Offered liquor and food to someone's tomb in a valley and wept for the deceased.
10304405.ch: 携带酒水美食，前往幽谷荒冢扫墓并祭祀故人，并于坟前洒泪痛哭。

10304406.en: Pursued by cultivators in Hua Feng and fled into a desolate valley to escape them.
10304406.ch: 受到华封州修仙者追踪，无奈避入荒谷，将其摆脱。

10304407.en: Broke an unknown seal in Hua Feng and looted the treasure within.
10304407.ch: 于华封州某秘境中解开不知名封印，并带走其中秘宝。

10304408.en: Assaulted by monsters after breaking a seal in Hua Feng's mystic realm and had a narrow escape.
10304408.ch: 探索华封州秘境，成功解除一处封印后受到妖兽围攻，几经周折终于脱离险境。

10304409.en: Broke two seals in Hua Feng but induced a thunderstorm.
10304409.ch: 于华封州秘境探索，成功解除两处封印，招来雷暴天气。

10304410.en: Explored a mystic realm in Hua Feng and got some treasures.
10304410.ch: 于华封州秘境中进行探索，成功获得宝物若干。
